what_its_for: This eye drop is used to treat dry eye disease. It works by coating the surface of your eye and reducing tear evaporation, helping to keep your eyes moist and comfortable. It is approved for adults.
how_to_take: Wash your hands before using this medicine. Tilt your head back, pull down your lower eyelid to make a small pocket, and place one drop into the affected eye(s). Close your eye gently and press lightly on the inner corner of your eye for about 1 minute — this helps keep the medicine in your eye. Do not touch the dropper tip to your eye, eyelid, or any other surface to avoid contamination. If you wear contact lenses, remove them before using the drops and wait at least 15 minutes before putting your lenses back in.
dosing: Use one drop in the affected eye(s) four times a day, roughly every 4 to 6 hours while you are awake. Follow your eye doctor's specific instructions, as your dose may vary.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not use two drops at once to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C and 25°C). Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use. Do not freeze. Keep out of reach of children. Discard the bottle 60 days after you first open it, even if there is medicine remaining.
what_to_avoid: Avoid touching the dropper tip to any surface, including your eye or fingers, to prevent contamination. Do not wear contact lenses while you are applying the drops — wait at least 15 minutes after use before reinserting your lenses. Avoid rubbing your eyes right after applying the drops.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your eye doctor if you experience eye pain, sudden changes in vision, increased redness or irritation, or if your dry eye symptoms are not improving or are getting worse. Also call if you accidentally get more drops in your eye than instructed, or if you notice unusual discharge from your eye.
when_it_works: You may begin to notice improvement in your dry eye symptoms within a few weeks of starting treatment. However, it may take up to 8 weeks to feel the full benefit. Continue using the drops as directed even if your eyes start to feel better.
special_populations: This medication has only been studied in adults. It is not approved for use in children. There is limited information on use during pregnancy or breastfeeding — talk to your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding.
